description: Canonical machine-readable MCP tool contract registry. Build tooling dereferences shared definitions before publishing each MCP Tool.inputSchema and Tool.outputSchema.

playerIdentifier.description: Steam account ID, SteamID64, or an https://stratz.com/players/... profile URL.

imp.description: STRATZ Individual Match Performance (IMP) for this player when upstream provides it. Null means unavailable for the match/player.

stratz_server_info.description: Return server, protocol, schema, cache, limit, and upstream connectivity information without secrets.

stratz_get_player.description: Get a normalized STRATZ player profile by account ID, SteamID64, or STRATZ profile URL.

stratz_list_player_matches.description: List normalized matches for a player using bounded filters and an authenticated opaque cursor.

stratz_batch_get_players.description: Get up to 25 players atomically; any item failure fails the entire batch.

stratz_get_match.description: Get a normalized Dota match with detail-level controlled timelines and replay-derived events.

stratz_batch_get_matches.description: Get up to 25 matches atomically; any item failure fails the entire batch.

stratz_get_hero.description: Get normalized hero reference data by numeric ID, exact localized name, or canonical slug.

stratz_get_hero_stats.description: Get bounded aggregate hero statistics for a date, patch, rank, role, and lane window.

stratz_batch_get_heroes.description: Get up to 25 heroes atomically; any item failure or ambiguity fails the entire batch.

stratz_list_leagues.description: Search and list STRATZ leagues with bounded filters and an authenticated opaque cursor.

stratz_get_league.description: Get normalized league metadata by exact league ID.

stratz_list_league_matches.description: List matches for a league with bounded date/patch filters and an authenticated opaque cursor.

stratz_list_live_matches.description: List current live matches with bounded filters, sorting, and a short-lived authenticated cursor.

stratz_get_constants.description: Get one explicit class of STRATZ/Dota reference constants, or all classes when requested.

stratz_execute_graphql.description: Execute one guarded GraphQL query against an approved STRATZ root field using JSON-compatible variables.
